card.name: Scattered punctuation and digits in citations
card.fires_on: Single punctuation marks, digits or small linking words at points of transition in academic text, such as a dash before an author name in a reference list or a digit inside a year.

modes.label: Reference list punctuation
modes.description: A dash or symbol that separates a citation from the next author name.

modes.label: Digits inside years
modes.description: The first or second digit of a year in a citation or date range.
modes.example: Erickson, D. B., & Touyz, S. W. (<<2>>003). Parent-child interaction therapy

modes.label: Linking words in academic prose
modes.description: Words like well in as well as, or a contraction, in explanatory text.
modes.example: balance and transitivity, as<< well>> as social equality

card.plain: It fires on small bits of punctuation and numbers in scholarly references and prose, with no single theme.
